title: Crunchy Fries
description: Par-boiled, double-fried fries with a glassy, shatteringly crisp shell.

ingredients.item: neutral oil for frying (peanut or canola)

steps: Peel the potatoes (optional) and cut into 1 cm batons. Rinse in cold water until the water runs mostly clear.
Put them in a pot with about 8 cups of cold water, the vinegar and 1 tbsp salt. Bring to a boil and simmer 8–10 minutes, until tender but not falling apart.
Drain gently and spread on a rack or towel. Let them steam-dry for 10 minutes — the roughed-up surface is what makes them crunchy.

Heat the oil to 190°C (375°F) in a heavy pot at least 5 cm deep. Fry in batches for about 1 minute, just until a pale skin forms. Drain on a rack and let cool for at least 30 minutes (or freeze at this stage).
Reheat the oil to 190°C and fry again in batches for 3–4 minutes, until deep golden and crisp.
Drain, toss immediately with the fine salt and serve hot.
